description: This file contains unit tests for serialization behavior in the Orleans framework, focusing on generic base classes. It defines an abstract generic base class, a derived class, and a test class that verifies whether the serializer recognizes the derived class as serializable based on attribute markings.

classes.name: Base<T>
classes.description: An abstract generic base class marked with [GenerateSerializer] attribute, used as a serialization candidate in tests.

classes.name: Derived
classes.description: A class inheriting from Base<int>, used to test serialization capabilities.

classes.name: GenericBaseClassTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies if the serializer recognizes the Derived class as serializable.

methods.name: GenericBaseClassTest
methods.description: Constructor that sets up dependency injection and serializer instance for testing.

methods.name: DerivedNoGeneric
methods.description: A test method that asserts the Derived class is not recognized as serializable by the serializer.
